cc:Work.dc:description: PPO minus PPO-TRS front/hind RAW torque-squared imbalance in percentage points. The 144 values were transcribed from the supplied heatmap at its displayed one-decimal precision; each source cell is a mean of 100 parallel trials. Values are not normalized by effort limits. Robot names updated to Go2, X1-Opposed, and X1-Aligned. No data clipping or experiment recomputation.
